required_documents.name: SF-424 Application for Federal Assistance
required_documents.details: Standard federal grant application cover form submitted through Grants.gov.

required_documents.name: Project Narrative / Scope of Work
required_documents.details: Detailed project narrative detailing objectives, technical work plan, community impact, and performance measures.

required_documents.name: SF-424A Budget Information and Budget Narrative
required_documents.details: Detailed budget breakdown and justification explaining all direct costs and federally negotiated indirect rates.

required_documents.name: Project Abstract Summary
required_documents.details: Concise public abstract outlining project goals, activities, and expected public benefits.

required_documents.name: Letters of Support and Collaboration
required_documents.details: Letters from cooperating community partners, state agencies, or academic institutions endorsing the project.

required_documents.name: SAM.gov UEI and Grants.gov Registration
required_documents.details: Active SAM.gov registration with Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) and Grants.gov credentials.

eligibility.summary: Applications are encouraged from a variety of individuals and organizations, including but not limited to: non-governmental/civil society organizations, think tanks, educational institutions or subsets thereof, and non-profit organizations. Prior programmatic experience is desired, along with experience managing budgets. In North Carolina, eligible entities fitting the organizational requirements may apply.

cost_share.details: No cost sharing or non-federal matching funds are required.

review_criteria.criterion: Work Plan Feasibility and Milestone Schedule

submission_limits: Institutional limits apply as detailed in the opportunity announcement; verify internal screening procedures.
important_notes: Application submission is administered via Grants.gov or the designated federal portal for opportunity PAS-AUS-FY2017-1.
SAM.gov registration must be active with valid Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) prior to submission; allow 3-4 weeks for new registrations.
Review all instructions, eligibility requirements, and deadlines published on Grants.gov before preparing submission.
